# Vendored third-party libraries

This folder holds the runtime dependencies committed verbatim into the repo
(rather than resolved from `node_modules/`, which is gitignored) so the
zero-build app keeps working from static hosting with no install step and the
exact versions stay pinned. Everything here is imported by **relative path**
(e.g. `./vendor/...` from `index.html`, `../vendor/...` from `src/`) — there is
no import map.

## Generated by `npm run vendor`

`scripts/vendor.js` copies these out of `node_modules` after an `npm install`
(re-run it after bumping the versions in `package.json`):

- `tutuca-extra.js` — tutuca's browser build, bundling the margaui compile
  helpers (`compile`, `compileClassesToStyleText`, `injectCss`) on top of the
  core tutuca API.
- `margaui.min.js` — the in-browser Tailwind/daisyUI-compatible compiler.
- `themes/` — every margaui theme stylesheet; the in-app theme switcher swaps
  between them at runtime, so the whole folder is vendored.

## Hand-vendored

- `uFuzzy.mjs` / `uFuzzy.d.ts` — the fuzzy matcher used by the live search and
  the DOM highlighter.
  - **Source:** https://github.com/leeoniya/uFuzzy (`@leeoniya/ufuzzy`)
  - **Version:** 1.0.19
  - **License:** MIT (header retained in the file)
  - To update: `npm pack @leeoniya/ufuzzy@<version>`, unpack, copy
    `package/dist/uFuzzy.mjs` and `package/dist/uFuzzy.d.ts` here, and bump the
    version above.
